finding.claim: Git.ls_remote's unsafe-option guard omits the short form `-u` for `--upload-pack`, so an untrusted positional argument such as `-utouch /tmp/pwn` or `-u`,`touch /tmp/pwn` reaches `git ls-remote` and sets the upload-pack command, which git runs as a shell command. Other blocklists (clone: repo/base.py:152-155; archive: repo/base.py:185-190) include the short form.
finding.source: Untrusted string passed as a positional argument to Git().ls_remote(...) by the calling application, with allow_unsafe_options left at False (cmd.py:1130-1133).
finding.sink: git ls-remote process spawned via _call_process (cmd.py:1144) with the attacker token as an option; git runs the -u/--upload-pack value as the transport helper command.

trace.note: ls_remote guard runs only when allow_unsafe_options is False
_option_candidates collects args starting with '-', so '-utouch /tmp/pwn' or '-u' is a candidate
unsafe_short_options is built only from single-dash entries in the blocklist; none exist for ls-remote
options_are_kwargs is False for dash-prefixed input
single-dash branch: 'u' has no unsafe mapping and is not in clusterable_short_options '46flnqsv', so the loop breaks
prefix-match branch skipped for single-dash tokens, so no error is raised
_call_process('ls_remote', *args) with no '--' separator before the attacker token

finding.guards_checked: check_unsafe_options canonicalization and abbreviation handling (cmd.py:980-1042); allow_unsafe_options default False; kwargs spellings like upload_pack= are blocked; the clone path (repo/base.py:1541-1543) places '--' before the URL and is not affected; submodule name validation and path containment (submodule/base.py:308-317, 417-426) block traversal. Not executed: Bash was unavailable, so the end-to-end git behavior is inferred from reading the code and git's documented -u/--upload-pack equivalence.
